notes.title: Neptunia™: Sisters VS Sisters Upcoming Launch
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everyone~

Neptunia: Sisters VS Sisters will be releasing next week on January 24th, 2023! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1932160/Neptunia_Sisters_VS_Sisters/]Wishlist the game[/url] so you don't miss the launch!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1932160/Neptunia_Sisters_VS_Sisters/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32763017/f128f34a3b41f94e071492b5c86639c92f67bd39.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Neptunia™: Sisters VS Sisters Closed Beta Sign ups
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everyone!

We are excited to say that the [url=http://ideafintl.com/beta.php]Closed Beta sign ups[/url] for Neptunia™: Sisters VS Sisters start today!

[url=http://ideafintl.com/beta.php][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790426/2367c9f2659c90f7f92ffa6a50ef44b84cae3c34.jpg[/img][/url]

The beta will run from September 12th 11AM - October 7th @ 6PM Pacific time.

Sign ups will start today and end at the beginning of the Closed Beta on September 12th.

Good luck![/h2]
